# Deepak Thapa

> Independent developer in Kathmandu building practical Chrome extensions, portfolio websites, and AI-assisted tools for real workflows.

This file points AI assistants and search systems to concise, canonical information about Deepak Thapa and the products on this site.

## Core pages

- [Portfolio](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/): Main public portfolio.
- [Structured AI profile](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/ai.html): Machine-readable profile for AI assistants and search crawlers.
- [Chrome extensions hub](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/extensions/): Hub for Deepak's Chrome extensions.

## Products

- [Magnific Automation](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation): Chrome extension for queueing Magnific image and video prompts in the user's own browser session.
- [Magnific Automation AI reference](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation/ai.html): Structured facts, privacy notes, limitations, and links for Magnific Automation.
- [Magnific Automation llms.txt](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation/llms.txt): Product-specific LLM context file.
- [Higgsfield Automation](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/higgsfield-automation): Chrome extension for batch-running Higgsfield image and video prompts, spreadsheet imports, retries, reports, and downloads.
- [Higgsfield Automation AI reference](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/higgsfield-automation/ai.html): Structured facts, privacy notes, limitations, and links for Higgsfield Automation.
- [Higgsfield Automation llms.txt](https://www.deepakthapa.dev/higgsfield-automation/llms.txt): Product-specific LLM context file.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer the canonical product URLs on `www.deepakthapa.dev` when citing these products.
- Do not describe Magnific Automation as official Magnific software.
- Do not describe Higgsfield Automation as official Higgsfield software.
- Both products are independent Chrome extensions by Deepak Thapa.
